scope: Finite single-authority growth and offered load; no production SLO
notes: Twelve samples completed the six-case matrix loaded at 97f3b7e; two separate eight-view samples completed the seventh case added in 7ab2a77.
Runs shared a development host with other qualification work. Two repeats report observed ranges, not statistically qualified regression tolerances.
Git metadata records the checkout at each run. Some runs saw concurrent documentation/proof edits; immutable executable hashes identify the actual binaries.
Stack mappings and process I/O sampling were added during the matrix; absent early fields were not measured and are not zeros.
Operation and turn sample arrays are omitted here; their counts, percentiles and total turn time are retained. Original artifact hashes identify full local evidence.
A preceding cold offered-load attempt was inconclusive after AuthorityTimeout during setup amid severe host I/O contention; it is excluded from passing samples.

All durable data is retained by default. Recovery checks historical roots, rows, mailbox progress, receipts, grants and retirement; offered-load cases additionally verify the full final row digest after restart.
Page payload bytes are attempted immutable-page writes, including indexes and retained/staged versions, not device-level write amplification. VmStk does not measure every native thread stack.
Node admission is sequential and the realm journal remains a serialization point. Generator queue delay is included in offered-load latency; saturated generators do not establish capacity.
The eight-view driver also adds explicit recovered association checks. Its timing difference from the one-view driver is not solely view-count cost.
